title: Archive Orientation / Navigation Exercise
summary: Demonstration of related-record navigation and archive classifications.
body:
NAVIGATION EXERCISE

This record is provided as a demonstration of how connected archive material is navigated.

RETURN TO PREVIOUS RECORD
If you reached this page by selecting a related record, the RETURN TO PREVIOUS RECORD section appears above this document. It identifies the record you came from and provides a direct link back to it.

RELATED RECORDS
Records may cite other records because they concern the same person, place, event, transaction, or archive action. Related records are shown at the end of a document. Selecting one follows that connection and establishes the current record as your previous record.

TRY IT
The following records demonstrate two other archive states:

ARC-326-0003 is a RESTRICTED record. Opening it will show the access-key prompt. The key for this record is ARCHIVE, but it is assumed you have been given any access-keys needed in either previous records or through administrative channels.

ARC-326-0004 is a WITHDRAWN record. Opening it will show the archive withdrawal notice instead of the record contents.

You can use the RETURN TO PREVIOUS RECORD link to work back through the chain.

This is the normal behaviour of connected Brightside records. The archive is not arranged as a single chronological list. Follow references, record the IDs that matter, and use direct retrieval when you already know where you need to go.
